Variants.Content: Entry Thern is the name of the settlement and tribe of free people in the Frostfang Mountains. The Thern people live in the alpine valleys and value bronze, weapons, order and clan identity. In the eyes of many free people, they appear to be more disciplined than other tribes; but they still do not accept the South The mountains force people to take grazing, hunting, minerals, mountain roads and short summers very seriously. An early snowfall can change the migration arrangements of the entire tribe. Thern's society has its own chieftains, customs, and conflicts, and cannot simply be called "barbarian."
